name: ZaapRush
summary:
ZaapRush is a free-to-play survival roguelite based on the universe of Dofus Retro.
Players choose a character class from the World of Twelve and fight against waves of monsters across dozens of different areas, including Astrub, Wabbit Island, and the Minotot's Labyrinth.
The game also features a profession system, allowing players to develop various crafting and gathering skills, as well as a breeding system for Dragoturkeys and pets.
